svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: What a Decision Tree Is Actually Doing
Try every feature at every threshold, keep the split that separates best, then recurse
A split earns its place by making the groups purer, not by flipping the answer. Depth 2 shown.
